verdict_text:
YES

The script casts exactly the 112 layer projection matrices to bfloat16 via a fullmatch on the enumerated names, leaves every other tensor as float32 with unchanged values, deletes nothing (`buffer_re` contains `(?!)`, a never-matching lookahead, so the skip branch is dead code — harmless given the input has no buffers), preserves names, and asserts all four required checks before writing. Sharding at the 268,435,456-byte limit is delegated to `save_sharded_safetensors`, which is outside the reviewed text.
